values.content: You are a medical regulatory expert. Extract structured drug safety information from FDA alerts. Always return valid JSON, no markdown.

=Extract drug safety info from this FDA alert.

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Content: {{ $json.contentSnippet || $json.content }}

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "drug_name": "Main drug name (DCI), or null",
  "drug_name_normalized": "lowercase alphanumeric only",
  "drug_name_aliases": ["Brand names"],
  "alert_type": "recall|black_box|contraindication|shortage|safety_communication|dose_adjustment|interaction_warning",
  "severity": "class_I|class_II|class_III|critical|moderate|low|null",
  "summary": "1-2 sentence summary",
  "affected_lots": [],
  "affected_countries": ["US"],
  "recommended_action": "What physicians should do",
  "extraction_confidence": 0.95
}

If no specific drug is identified (e.g. 'Quarterly Recall Summary'): drug_name = null.

meta.description: Hourly ingestion of FDA drug safety alerts. AI-extracts drug name, severity, recommended action. Posts to Vercel webhook for storage in drug_safety_alerts table.
